title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature provides insight into incoming requests, allowing for better debugging and issue tracking. It will log key request information such as method, path, and response status. This enhances the framework's overall transparency and maintainability
acceptance: The feature is accepted when logs are correctly generated for various request scenarios, including different HTTP methods and response codes
reason: Improved request logging is essential for a production-ready framework, enabling developers to monitor and troubleshoot their applications more effectively
